edges.reason: Constructor assigns creatorAddress = msg.sender, making the caller the privileged owner.
AccessControl constructor is the only place creatorAddress is initialized.
onlyCREATOR modifier compares msg.sender to creatorAddress before addSERAPHIM runs.
onlyCREATOR modifier compares msg.sender before removeSERAPHIM runs.
onlyCREATOR modifier compares msg.sender before updateMaintenanceMode runs.
onlyCREATOR gate protects withdrawEther with msg.sender check.
onlySERAPHIM modifier reads seraphims[msg.sender] to authorize privileged calls.
addSERAPHIM writes seraphims[_newSeraphim] = true, granting privileges.
addSERAPHIM increases totalSeraphims when a new seraphim is added.
addSERAPHIM performs the unchecked increment totalSeraphims += 1.
Result of totalSeraphims += 1 is stored back into the uint16 state variable.
removeSERAPHIM writes seraphims[_oldSeraphim] = false, revoking privileges.
removeSERAPHIM decreases totalSeraphims when a seraphim is removed.
removeSERAPHIM performs the unchecked decrement totalSeraphims -= 1.
Result of totalSeraphims -= 1 is stored back into the uint16 state variable.
updateMaintenanceMode rewrites the pause flag under the creator-only modifier.
withdrawEther executes the external transfer of the whole balance.
withdrawEther sends the balance to creatorAddress with no state update before the call.
External transfer may re-enter withdrawEther or dependent functions (unchecked state).
block.timestamp (now) is the value written into battleboard.lastMoveTime.
createBattleboard assigns lastMoveTime = now, a timestamp dependency.
createBattleboard calls getRandomNumber to pick monster positions.
createBattleboard increments totalBattleboards after pushing a board.
createBattleboard calls createNullTile for the newly created board.
Newly built Battleboard struct is pushed into Battleboards storage.
getRandomNumber derives randomness from block.blockhash, which is predictable.
getRandomNumber computes the genNum local from blockhash and privateAddress.
Randomness output depends on block context values under miner influence.
createNullTile pushes the sentinel tile into TilesonBoard.
createNullTile validates _battleboardId against totalBattleboards.
createTile pushes the assembled tile into TilesonBoard.
createTile writes angelsOnBattleboards[_angelId] = true without checking the board owner.
createTile performs numTiles += 1 and derives tile.id from it.
Incremented numTiles flows into Battleboards[_battleboardId].numTiles and tile.id.
createTile writes the new tile id into positionsTiles.
createTile populates the memory Tile struct with caller-supplied fields.
_owner parameter is stored directly into the new tile.
killTile performs unchecked numTeams1/numTeams2 -= 1 inside loops.
killTile mutates the tile isLive and tileType fields.
Loop index i drives the team array scans in killTile.
addTeamtoBoard mutates board team counters and player arrays.
owner parameter is compared against existing players and pushed.
team parameter selects team1 or team2 registration branch.
setTilePosition writes positionsTiles[_positionTo+1] = tileId.
setTilePosition updates the tile position field.
setTileHp overwrites the tile hp value.
addMedalBurned executes medalsBurned += 1 with no cap.
setLastMoveTime assigns now to lastMoveTime, a timestamp dependency.
block.timestamp is the value written by setLastMoveTime.
iterateTurn executes turn += 1 with no cap.
killBoard calls clearAngelsFromBoard to release locked angels.
clearAngelsFromBoard resets angelsOnBattleboards entries to false.
Loop index i iterates the tile array in clearAngelsFromBoard.
safeMult computes x * y before the overflow assert.
Parameter x is a multiplicand of the unguarded multiplication.
Parameter y is a multiplicand of the unguarded multiplication.
SafeDiv performs a / b without an explicit zero check.
_newSeraphim parameter determines which address receives privileges.
_oldSeraphim parameter determines which address loses privileges.
_isMaintaining parameter is written into isMaintenanceMode.
prize parameter is stored in the Battleboard struct and drives capacity logic.
restrictions parameter is stored in the Battleboard struct.
battleboardId parameter indexes Battleboards and TilesonBoard in killTile.
tileId parameter indexes the tile array without a bounds check.
killMonster zeroes monster1/monster2 on the referenced board.
getTileFromBattleboard reads a Tile from TilesonBoard storage.
getTileIDByOwner scans TilesonBoard tiles for a matching owner.
getTurn reads the players array using the current turn index.
getTotalBattleboards returns the totalBattleboards counter.

normalization_plan.reason: Parameter _newSeraphim only exists to be consumed by addSERAPHIM's seraphim grant.
Parameter _oldSeraphim only exists to be consumed by removeSERAPHIM's revocation.
Parameter _isMaintaining is directly assigned into the maintenance flag inside updateMaintenanceMode.
Parameter prize is only written into the Battleboard struct created by createBattleboard.
Parameter restrictions is only written into the Battleboard struct created by createBattleboard.
Parameter _owner is stored directly into the new tile by createTile.
Parameter owner is pushed into the board players/team arrays by addTeamtoBoard.
Parameter team only selects the branch (team1/team2) inside addTeamtoBoard.
Parameter battleboardId is the storage index used exclusively by killTile.
Parameter tileId is the array index used exclusively by killTile.
Parameter x is a direct operand of the multiplication in safeMult.
Parameter y is a direct operand of the multiplication in safeMult.
Loop counter i only drives the team array iterations and unchecked decrements in killTile.
Loop counter i only exists to walk the tile array in clearAngelsFromBoard.
Local genNum is a temporary derived from block.blockhash inside getRandomNumber.
Memory Tile struct tile is a temporary assembled and pushed by createTile.
